## Quality checklist

- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed
- [ ] Native keyboard and VoiceOver behavior is preserved
- [ ] Reduce Motion behavior was considered
- [ ] No telemetry, unnecessary permission, or private API was introduced
- [ ] Break cleanup and Emergency Exit remain safe
- [ ] Screenshots and logs contain no private information
